question: Which Nobel-winning British author explored apartheid-era South Africa in her 1974 novel "The Conservationist" ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nadine Gordimer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nadine Gordimer**, the Nobel Prize-winning author from **South Africa**, published the novel *The Conservationist* in **1974**.
 
• The novel explores the themes of **apartheid-era South Africa**, focusing on the deep political, social, and racial inequalities of the time.
 
• **The Conservationist** won the **Booker Prize** in 1974 and was widely praised for its profound exploration of identity, power, and land ownership during the apartheid regime.
